assertions.assertion: The claim is for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring
The required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes
This prior approval is now being requested to obtain the missing authorization and to ensure medical necessity and compliance with plan guidelines for this diagnostic procedure
